name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-10-24, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.83 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
